features.feature: House-format execution-plan doc at canonical decisions path with Story header, plan-only scope note, Problem/Principles/Architecture/Roadmap sections
Module decomposition: 4 core modules (experience-layer-types, learning-store, finding-signals, experience-hint-loader) and 2 handler modules (learning, playbook)
One-way inward coupling constraint: handler → core → types, zero outward imports from existing code
Reuse-not-rebuild decisions: extend dev-memory.ts, clone decision-doc-promotion.ts digest pattern, reuse activity-log.ts appendActivityLog
Explicit cut-FTS decision for v1 (no FTS engine; Level 2 recall uses structured filtering + existing story_list scan)
Determinism guardrail 1: audit-only finding fields (signatureTag, resolutionType, dismissReasonType, resolveEvidenceStrength, dismissEvidenceStrength) excluded from any gate read
Determinism guardrail 2: finding-signals read via stable finding accessor store.readFindings, never raw findings.json
Determinism guardrail 3: reviewer hints excluded from promptHash domain (or pinned per reviewRunId)
Back-compat rules: dismissReasonType optional; flat underscore command names
Phased roadmap with Phase 1a (verifiable finding-signals vertical slice) as first story, proven by unchanged currentMaterialHash() test
Code-anchor appendix listing real file paths (types.ts, finding.ts, store.ts, advisory.ts, dev-memory.ts, runtime-artifact-registry.ts, story-review.ts, activity-log.ts, decision-doc-promotion.ts)
No Co-Authored-By trailer anywhere in the doc
Implementing TypeScript modules, handlers, or runnable commands (source code)
features.excluded_by: Out of scope: implementing any TypeScript module, handler, or command

features.feature: Editing gate logic or existing repo files (other than adding the new doc)
features.excluded_by: Out of scope: editing gate logic, changing any existing repo file other than adding the new doc

features.feature: Building a full-text search or retrieval engine
features.excluded_by: Out of scope: building any search/retrieval engine
